scope: visible Playground development examples, not test

examples.source:
#!/bin/tcsh
set files = ( source.c source.h )

foreach file ( $files )
  if ( -f "$file" ) then
    echo "Found $file"
  endif
end

#!/bin/zsh
autoload -Uz colors
colors

typeset -a files
files=(app.ts app.tsx)

for file in $files; do
  print -r -- "${file:t}"
done

#!/usr/bin/env bash

name=Virgo
cat <<EOF
Hello $name!
This is a here document.
EOF

cat <<'LITERAL'
$name and $(date) remain literal text.
LITERAL

cat <<-TABS
	Leading tabs can be stripped.
	TABS

printf '%s\n' "Finished"
